Leon Black Sues US Congress Over Epstein Probe Subpoena

Billionaire investor Leon Black has sued the U.S. House Oversight Committee and Congress, defying a subpoena to testify in an investigation related to Jeffrey Epstein. Black's lawsuit challenges the committee's authority to compel him to share non-disclosure agreements. He was scheduled to appear for a deposition on Thursday but refused to comply with the subpoena. The committee is investigating Black's alleged ties to Epstein and seeking information about NDAs.
